content: EURO regulations Article 15 defines group tie-breakers: head-to-head points, head-to-head goal difference, head-to-head goals, recursive tied subset, then all-group goal difference, goals, away goals, wins, away wins, disciplinary points, and interim Nations League ranking. Article 23 defines cross-group rankings and excludes matches against fifth-placed teams for ranks 1-4 in groups of five; Article 24 says UEFA compiles fixtures after the draw with at least two rest days and same-group matchdays.
